section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews the development and cross-cultural validation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version (BAS-2). The present study aims to examine the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran, a non-Western culture increasingly influenced by Westernized media. The study will evaluate convergent validity, factor structure, internal consistency, and sex differences, hypothesizing that BAS-2 scores will be positively correlated with self-esteem and life satisfaction, negatively correlated with BMI, and that men will report higher body appreciation than women.
